title: 3 Kesalahan Video Produk HP yang Bikin Orang Tidak Jadi Beli

slides.headline: Video Produk HP Kamu Terlihat Murah?
slides.body: HP mahal tidak menjamin video terlihat mahal. Ini 3 kesalahan fatal yang bikin calon pembeli urung checkout!
slides.image_prompt: Split screen showing a dark grainy smartphone product shot on the left vs a sleek well-lit professional product video on the right, dark aesthetic background, high contrast, modern studio style.
slides.layout: Centered bold typography with a high-contrast visual comparison background.

slides.headline: Kesalahan #1: Lighting Asal-asalan
slides.body: Hanya mengandalkan lampu kamar bikin video redup, berbayang, dan grainy. Detail warna asli produk jadi tidak terlihat menarik.
slides.image_prompt: Iconography of a dim lightbulb with a red cross over a blurry phone camera view of a product, dark theme with warning highlight accents.
slides.layout: Top headline, visual graphics on the left, body text card on the right.

slides.headline: Kesalahan #2: Cuma Pakai Satu Angle
slides.body: Merekam produk dari satu posisi diam selama 15 detik itu membosankan. Penonton akan scroll lewat sebelum paham keunggulan produkmu.
slides.image_prompt: A static phone camera frame showing a single boring angle on a pedestal, clean minimalist graphic design.
slides.layout: Headline at top left, body text middle left, large graphic illustration on the right.

slides.headline: Kesalahan #3: Gerakan Kamera Shakey
slides.body: Tangan gemetar saat transisi bikin video kelihatan amatiran. Tanpa pergerakan halus, estetikanya langsung hilang.
slides.image_prompt: Smartphone with motion blur lines illustrating camera shake, professional dark mode UI presentation.
slides.layout: Headline top center, icon with motion elements center, body text bottom center.

slides.headline: Solusi: Gunakan Pola 4 Shot Sederhana
slides.body:
1. Establishing (Suasana)
2. Medium Shot (Bentuk produk)
3. Close-Up (Detail/Tekstur)
4. Action Shot (Saat digunakan)
slides.image_prompt: A clean grid layout of 4 storyboard frames showing a product from establishing shot to detailed close-up, modern infographic style.
slides.layout: Headline top, 2x2 grid layout with numbered step icons and clear short labels.

slides.headline: Nggak Ada Waktu Edit Biar Kelihatan Mewah?
slides.body: Kirim video mentahan HP kamu, biarkan Bos Sony Creative Studio sulap jadi video iklan profesional. DM 'EDIT' sekarang!
slides.image_prompt: Sleek dark luxury branding slide for Bos Sony Creative Studio with a vibrant CTA button design and high-end video editor workspace in background.
slides.layout: Centered call to action, prominent brand typography, button element at bottom.
